What needs your attention

Read this comparison correctly

Assumes you will select overwrite products with matching handles during Shopify import.

  • A blank supplied field can overwrite existing data.
  • An omitted column is different from an empty cell.
  • An absent variant is a review flag, not proof that Shopify will delete it.
  • Image availability, apps, metafields and store rules are not verified.
